title: घरेलु कामदार बालबालिकाहरूको शैक्षिक अवस्था Gharelu Kamdar Balbalikaharuko Shaikshik Awastha
authors: वेल्वासे Belbase, नारायण Narayan प्रसाद Prasad
nepali: लेखको शीर्षक घरेलु कामदार बालबालिकाहरूको शैक्षिक अवस्था रहेको छ ।यसको उद्देश्य घरेलु कामदार वालकालिकाहरूले शिक्षा आर्जनमा सामाना गनुपर्नेसमस्याहरूको पहिचान गरी सुझाव दिनु रहेको छ । यो अध्ययन १० देखि १६ वर्ष उमेरसमूहका २० जना केटाकेटीहरूमा सीमित गरिएको छ । लेखको ढा“चा गुणात्मक रपरिमाणात्मक छ । तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गर्न प्राथमिक तथा द्वितीय स्रोतहरूको प्रयोगगरिएको छ । छलफल र नतिजाअन्र्तगत घरेलु बलश्रमिकका विभिन्न समस्याहरू, जस्तै–वैयक्तिक, परिवारिक, आर्थिक तथा सामाजिक, नीतिगत, भेदभाव, शैक्षिक, साथीसमूहसँगजोडिएका समस्याहरूका साथै शैक्षिक पह“ुच बढाउने उपायहरूको व्याख्या तथासुझावहरू दिइएको छ ।
american_english: The title of the article is 'The Educational Situation of Domestic Worker Children.' Its objective is to identify the problems that domestic worker children face in acquiring education and to offer suggestions. This study is limited to 20 boys and girls in the 10 to 16 year age group. The design of the article is qualitative and quantitative. Primary and secondary sources have been used to collect data. Under discussion and results, an account is given of the various problems of domestic child labourers, such as personal, family, economic and social, policy-related, discrimination, educational, and peer-group-related problems, together with an explanation of measures to increase educational access, and suggestions are offered.
british_english: The title of the article is 'The Educational Situation of Domestic Worker Children.' Its aim is to identify the problems that children of domestic workers face in obtaining an education and to make suggestions. This study is confined to 20 boys and girls in the 10 to 16 years age group. The design of the article is qualitative and quantitative. Primary and secondary sources have been used to gather data. Under discussion and results, the various problems of domestic child labourers, such as personal, family, economic and social, policy-related, discrimination, educational and peer-group-related problems, are set out, together with an explanation of measures to improve educational access, and suggestions are made.
